body.value: Information not about the place itself, but about the images the utamakura evokes and connected terms like kakekotoba etc. are presented. In a first step, terms associated with any utamakura were identified using Haikai ruisenshū sakuin (Han'an Noma Kōshin-sensei kakō kinenkai, 1973–1975). In a second step, these were then narrowed down to around 10 words, using Katagiri Yōichi's Utamakura utakotoba jiten.
